documentInfo.participation: Chief Justice Roberts announced the judgment and delivered the Court opinion in Parts I, II–A–1, and II–B, joined by Justices Sotomayor, Kagan, Gorsuch, Barrett, and Jackson. Parts II–A–2 and III are a plurality opinion joined only by Justices Gorsuch and Barrett.
